answer: Force each new identity to enter through a rate-limited payment inlet that issues a unique, slashable work-bond. Bonds are wired into a trellis of co-spend and co-attestation edges, and any later collision cuts the whole connected component, burning every bond in it. Because the bond steps up with each additional account from the same inlet, planting a meadow of yarrow-like clones costs linear capital up front and loses the entire cluster after one proven collision, which makes a cheap majority uneconomic.
